🇲🇽🏭 CHINESE CARS JUST PASSED GERMANY IN MEXICO

Chinese brands captured 11.5% of Mexico's auto market in the first half of 2026, displacing Germany as the third-largest source of light vehicles sold here. June alone hit 126,778 new units — up 7.6%, the strongest month since 2017 — led by the MG5 at 14,378 sold. Trade diversification isn't a slogan in Mexico; it's what people are driving.

🇲🇽🏆 THE WORLD CUP CASH CAME FROM MEXICANS, NOT TOURISTS

Deloitte puts Mexico's 2026 World Cup windfall at 2,543 million dollars — 7% under projection, because FIFA's dynamic-pricing scheme priced fans out and cut expected visitors from 836,000 to 494,000. The domestic market carried it anyway: gastronomy added 584 million dollars, retail 433 million, and 296,000 of those "tourists" were Mexicans spending at home. Corporate ticketing overreached; local consumption delivered.

🇲🇽🛢️ 20,000 LITERS OF STOLEN FUEL PULLED OFF THE ROAD IN GUANAJUATO

Federal and state forces stopped a tractor-trailer carrying roughly 20,000 liters of hydrocarbon with zero fiscal invoices near San José Iturbide, under "Operativo Blindaje Guanajuato" — the sustained deployment credited with cutting cargo theft along the industrial corridor. It's the same huachicol economy that just sent ex-PAN governor Ruffo to prison, dismantled one freight truck at a time.

🔥🇲🇽 US AGENCIES RAN THE ZAMBADA SNATCH ON MEXICAN SOIL

A Contralínea investigation lays out how the DEA, FBI and Homeland Security organized and executed the July 2024 capture of Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada in Culiacán, then flew him to Santa Teresa, New Mexico. Attorney General Ernestina Godoy calls it "an operation executed on Mexican territory... affecting the sovereignty of our country" — and ex-ambassador Ken Salazar's denial collapsed the moment the FBI put the very plane he swore wasn't theirs on display.

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO GRABS THE CARTEL'S MONEY MAN — 145M PESOS, 15 SUPERCARS

Mexican marines and the FGR captured Justo Aurelio Rivera Parrazales in Mérida — flagged by the Security Cabinet as one of the Cártel del Noreste's principal money launderers. Four raids seized 15 luxury cars (Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche), jewelry, weapons and cash totaling 145.2 million pesos. The 4T security model dismantles the financial architecture, not just the gunmen.

🇲🇽⚽ The 2026 World Cup is over. Sheinbaum's closing verdict: Mexico was the best host. "Felicidades a todas y todos los mexicanos por hacer de México la mejor sede, y a nuestra Selección Nacional por el gran papel que desempeñó, poniendo en alto el nombre de nuestro país con entrega, talento y orgullo." "Congratulations to all Mexicans for making Mexico the best host, and to our National Team for the great role it played, raising our country's name with dedication, talent and pride." — Claudia Sheinbaum, after the final in New York, July 19, 2026 Spain beat Argentina to take the title. Mexico co-hosted the tournament with the U.S. and Canada, staging matches in Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey.

🇲🇽✊ "Mexicanas y mexicanos trabajadores, los quiere y admira todo México." "Gracias por recibirme con tanto cariño… Son más que correspondidos. Mexicanas y mexicanos trabajadores, los quiere y admira todo México." "Thank you for receiving me with such affection… It's more than reciprocated. Working Mexican women and men — all of Mexico loves and admires you." — Claudia Sheinbaum, thanking the Mexican community on arriving in New York She landed in New York for the World Cup final and thanked the Mexican community that welcomed her — the largest immigrant population in the United States.

🇲🇽🌎 Three host nations, one stage. "Consideré que es importante en términos diplomáticos que estemos los tres países que fuimos sedes de esta Copa del Mundo y además es una muestra de que hay buena coordinación, buena colaboración con el gobierno de los Estados Unidos." "I considered it important, diplomatically, that the three countries that hosted this World Cup be present — and it's a sign that there is good coordination, good collaboration with the U.S. government." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on attending the final at Trump's invitation, alongside Canadian PM Mark Carney

🇲🇽⚽ Mexico co-hosted the 2026 World Cup. Sheinbaum went to the final to represent it. "Así que vamos a representar a México el día de mañana y estaremos el lunes temprano en la Ciudad de México." "So we are going to represent Mexico tomorrow, and we'll be back in Mexico City early Monday." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on attending the 2026 World Cup final Mexico, the United States and Canada jointly hosted the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Sheinbaum attended the final at the New York–New Jersey stadium and returned to Mexico City the following morning.

🇲🇽💵 REMITTANCES TO MEXICO CLIMB 2.8% — TRUMP'S CRACKDOWN CAN'T STOP THE FLOW

Mexico took in $25,287 million in remittances from January to May, up 2.8% year-on-year, with May alone hitting $5,611 million — a 3.8% jump, per Banxico (via El Financiero). It's the recovery after 2025's first annual decline in 11 years, and it comes despite Washington's new remittance tax and mass-deportation drive. Mexican workers abroad keep sending home more, not less.
